front.title: From the Field to the Protocol: Guidance for Civil Society on Informing IETF Work

abstract.t:
Civil society organizations (CSOs) document how Internet protocols and their deployments affect people around the world, yet their participation in the IETF has been limited and difficult to sustain, particularly for organizations based in the Global South. This document offers guidance to CSOs on how their research and field experience can inform the work of the IETF and IRTF. It points to areas where IETF work and CSO interests overlap, explains how field observations can be described so that the technical community can use them, and identifies venues where this work can be shared. The aim is to inform, not to determine, restrict, or dictate, the design and deployment of Internet protocols in the public interest.
It is a contribution to the Human Rights Protocol Considerations Research Group (HRPC) of the IRTF.
